# RKKP Skizofreni

RKKP Skizofreni is a Danish quality register — comparable in structure to the ADHD database discussed in the source material — that is cited as a precedent in debates over who is allowed to diagnose patients. According to the ADHD_2024.pdf report, the group behind RKKP Skizofreni has already included Specialpsykologer (specialist psychologists) alongside Speciallæger (specialist physicians) in its diagnostic criteria, and it did so "uden behov for at lave yderligere forarbejde" — without needing to carry out additional preparatory work [^src1].

The entity appears in the corpus specifically as a comparative reference point within an appendix to the Danish ADHD database's annual report. That appendix documents calculation rules and population definitions for the ADHD database — a nationwide register covering children, adolescents, and adults with ADHD, organized around an assessment population and a treatment population — and also compiles regional feedback from five Danish regions on their performance against various indicators. In that context, Region Sjælland had specifically proposed that Specialpsykologer be included in the diagnostic criterion for indicator 3, on the grounds of their statutory competence to issue psychiatric diagnoses. RKKP Skizofreni is invoked as evidence that this kind of inclusion has already been implemented elsewhere for several years without requiring extra groundwork, lending weight to the argument for extending similar recognition to Specialpsykologer within the ADHD database's own criteria [^src1].

No relationships or timeline events for RKKP Skizofreni are recorded in the corpus beyond this single, but substantive, comparative claim.
